meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会针对 Git 提交和历史调查任务，先分类请求（提交/变基/历史/状态），再读取仓库状态，按原子提交、重写历史、引用证据等规则操作，最后报告命令、哈希与你想要的结论。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交或调查 Git 历史时触发，例如你要求提交更改、问某行谁改的，或要求 rebase、squash 等重写历史操作。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动按功能分成几个原子提交
say.note: Claude 会先看 diff，再分组提交并报告哈希

say.text: 查一下这个文件这段是谁最后一次改的
say.note: 用 git blame 定位并给出证据

say.text: 把最近三个提交 rebase 合并成一个
say.note: 进入 rebase 模式，操作前会确认安全

howto.what_en: After install, Claude handles Git commit and history tasks by first classifying the request (commit/rebase/history/status), reading repository state, then operating per atomic-commit, history-rewrite, and evidence rules, finally reporting commands, hashes, and the requested conclusion.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or Git-history investigation, such as asking to commit changes, querying who changed a line, or requesting rebase, squash, or other history-rewriting operations.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several atomic commits
say_en.note: Claude inspects diff, groups, commits, then reports hashes

say_en.text: Check who last changed this section of this file
say_en.note: Uses git blame to locate and show evidence

say_en.text: Rebase the last three commits into one
say_en.note: Enters rebase mode with safety checks first
